name: Colwyn Bay Foodbank
lng: Trussell Trust foodbank in Colwyn Bay
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Paul's Church. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Conwy County Council Allotments
short_description: Conwy Council allotment sites in Colwyn Bay area
description: Council manages sites at Rhos-on-Sea and Old Colwyn. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and tool storage.

name: Pensarn Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Pensarn near the promenade
description: Volunteer-run community garden near Pensarn promenade growing coastal-hardy vegetables. Harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
